text:
**Repotting:** Wait 2-3 weeks after your plant arrives before repotting. Also, if you repot into non-Leafy soil within the first 14 days, a guarantee claim wouldn't be covered, so it's best to hold off at least that long.

**Watering:** Water only when the top inch of soil is dry. Overwatering is the most common cause of early problems. Also keep the plant out of direct sun for the first week.

I don't have specific watering schedules for individual plant types, but a Plant Care Specialist can give you free advice by chat or email if you tell them which plant you have.
